recipeInstructions.text: Rinse quinoa and combine with chicken broth and a pinch of salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer until absorbed, 12-15 minutes. Fluff and spread on a plate to cool.
Slice chicken breast into 1/4-inch strips and season with salt and black pepper.

itemListElement.text: Whisk soy sauce, the juice of orange, chicken broth, honey, and cornstarch.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Stir-fry the chicken with garlic and fresh ginger until cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Move to a plate.
In the same pan, stir-fry red bell pepper and sugar snap peas until crisp-tender, 2-3 minutes. Stir the glaze, add it, and cook until thickened, 1-2 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the quinoa, and toss in the glaze 1 minute. Off the heat, fold in arugula until just wilted. Season to taste.
Garnish with scallions and toasted sesame seeds, and serve with lime.
Partly freezing the chicken makes it easier to slice thin. Leftovers keep 2 days; reheat with a splash of broth.
